dataset_metadata.name: Multi-Stage Lithium Ion Battery Aging Study (BaPoBs - Samsung INR21700-50E)
dataset_metadata.institution: Munich University of Applied Sciences (HM) / ISES; Siemens AG; Hoppecke Systemtechnik GmbH
dataset_metadata.citation: Stroebl, F. et al. A multi-stage lithium-ion battery aging dataset using various experimental design methodologies. Scientific Data 11, 1020 (2024). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-024-03859-z
dataset_metadata.funding: German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy (BaPoBs project); Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG), project number 512819356

cell_info.cell_notes: Maximum charge current 4.9 A (1C); maximum discharge current 9.8 A (2C). Cell weight measured at delivery and recorded in experiments_meta.csv.

aging_modes.notes: Two-stage multi-DoE design. Stage 1: full-factorial (FF) and conditioned Latin hypercube (cLH) sampling for calendar (11 TPs) and cycle (25 TPs) aging respectively. Stage 2: pi-OED (model-based parameter individual optimal experimental design) plus a second non-model-based exploration study for calendar (4+3+4 TPs) and cycle (12+12 TPs) aging. Each test point (TP) typically repeated with 3 cells (01-03); some calendar TPs additionally tested with cells 04-06 (ET/AT only, no regular RPTs during aging). 279 cells tested under 93 different conditions across 71 distinct aging test points. Both calendar and cycle aging included.

time_protocol.test_equipment: BaSyTec GSM, BaSyTec XCTS, BaSyTec CTS Lab, BaSyTec CTS (various models across three labs: Siemens, Hoppecke/Intilion, Munich University of Applied Sciences); BaSyTest Control Software V6.2.53
time_protocol.notes: Each of the two stages was planned for approximately one year. Data time axis extends to ~400 days for calendar aging and ~4000 FEC for cycle aging. Cells connected to testers only during RPTs and cycling; calendar aging cells disconnected between RPTs to simulate open-loop storage. Sampling recorded as HH:mm:ss.SSS (sub-second resolution). Total dataset ~9.59 GB compressed, ~100 GB uncompressed.

rawdata.data_quality_notes: All files include a step_type column for easy extraction of specific test sections. A *_meta.txt companion file accompanies each measurement file with metadata (lab ID, cell serial, TP ID, measurement start date, device, channel, chamber, temperature setpoint, cell position). An experiments_meta.csv overview file covers all cells.
rawdata.known_issues: Multiple known incidents documented in the paper including tester malfunctions, lab blackouts, climate chamber downtime, and cell holder connection failures affecting specific test points in both Stage 1 and Stage 2. Individual corrupt files may be present; authors recommend dropping these prior to processing unless outlier analysis is intended.

checkup.notes: Three RPT types used: Initial/Final Check-Up (ET/AT, ~220 h, at Tamb = 10, 23, 45 C): capacity (CCCV), pOCV curves in both directions, HPPC at SOC 5-95%; Extended Check-Up (exCU, ~30 h, at Tamb = 23 C): capacity + HPPC at multiple SOCs; Standard Check-Up (CU, ~15 h, at Tamb = 23 C): capacity + HPPC at 50% SOC only. DCIR extracted from 1C discharge pulse at 50% SOC. Calendar aging RPT schedule: 5W-4W-8W-8W intervals (Stage 1); cycle aging RPT schedule: 1W-1W-1W-2W-2W-2W-4W-4W-4W-4W intervals. Scope of RPTs was varied throughout to minimize impact on cell degradation. Three full-cycles at 23 C performed before ET as break-in.

notes: The BaPoBs dataset is a large-scale, multi-stage battery aging study specifically designed to validate and compare design-of-experiments (DoE) methodologies including full-factorial, conditioned Latin hypercube, and model-based pi-OED approaches. Aging factors studied: ambient temperature (Tamb), maximum state of charge (SOCmax), depth of discharge (DOD), charge C-rate (C_ch), and discharge C-rate (C_dch). Charge/discharge C-rates for cycling constrained by manufacturer datasheet to C_ch in [0.05, 1] and C_dch in [0.05, 2]; SOC during cycling kept within 20-80% to maintain CC operation and avoid CV phases. Calendar aging cells stored at open-circuit in climate chambers with SOC set via CCCV charging prior to storage intervals. Stage 2 calendar aging capped SOCmax at 80% due to non-monotonic behavior observed above 80% in Stage 1. Three institutions participated: Siemens (SIE, Zwickau), Hoppecke/Intilion (INT), and Munich University of Applied Sciences (HM, Munich). Data available on Figshare under CC BY 4.0. Python analysis scripts and Jupyter notebook available at https://github.com/fst2112/Multi-Stage-Lithium-Ion-Battery-Aging-Dataset-Analysis.
